answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 5968 Country: India Title: I have been engaged and i would like to know whether i can talk with her in phone or meet her in private, since our marriage is after six month from now. Question: Assalaamualeikum Brothers, I have been engaged and i would like to know whether i can talk with her in phone or meet her in private, since our marriage is after six month from now. Zazaak-allah. Answer ID: 5968 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 633/590=L/1429) Talking to the girl and meeting her in privacy is unlawful and haram , since untill you are not married she is like non-mahram to you and privacy with such woman is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
